text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was watching a race held inside 
the VR Umalator on a street monitor. That 
race was——

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
——Second favorite, number 8, El Condor 
Pasa! A dignified entrance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(My excitement won't stop...! To think El 
is running on a European racecourse!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué...?! El gets to race against overseas 
horse girls?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! We have arranged to hold a 
race in the virtual space of the VR 
Umalator to compete against horse girls 
from across the globe, and——

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I want you to run on the European 
racecourse as the representative of Tracen 
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The entire world is watching this race! 
After all... a horse girl who previously 
won the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe will be 
competing!

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, her opponent is a "Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe winner"?! Isn't this... honestly 
way too tough?

text_block_list.name: Tall Man
text_block_list.text:
If it were a Japanese racecourse, maybe, 
but... Well! Even if she loses, it'll be 
good experience, right?
choice_data_list:
(Admittedly, the odds might be against 
her, but...)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Gathering top horse girls from around the 
globe, the International Exchange 
Race——has just begun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah...! The turf is clinging to 
my legs...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(Not only that... the shape of the course 
and the flow of the race are completely 
different from Japan...!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However——all of this! Is entirely within 
El's expectations!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa accelerates further on the 
final straight! Nobody can catch the 
crimson silks!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She crosses the finish line in first 
place! She did it! A splendid victory 
against Europe's finest competitors!

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
No way... She actually beat a "Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe winner" on a European 
track...!

text_block_list.name: El's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be?! If it's El-chan, even the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe might be...! 
Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Deepest thanks, boundless thrill, El is 
touched! Thank you all so much for your 
support!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm certain! El will definitely 
deliver an amazing run in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And then... and then!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After winning the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe—— I will spread my wings toward 
grand stages across the world!!

text_block_list.name: Tall Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What did she just say? ...After the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is where the 
world's horse girls gather! It's El's 
greatest goal!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yet, there are still other races out there 
hailed as the pinnacle of the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The gorgeous, dazzling races of Dubai, the 
prestigious, traditional races of Great 
Britain, the races of America overflowing 
with dreams and freedom——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El wants to win every single one of them! 
And that is by no means an impossible 
daydream!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter the environment, if you face it 
head-on, you can overcome it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That even Japanese horse girls can fight 
on the global stage, El has proven with 
this race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I declare! El shall one day 
soar high across the entire world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because! Standing right here right now is 
the crimson "monstrous bird" who traverses 
the globe——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (——WOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Absolutely incredible! Go 
for it, El Condor Pasa! Show us that 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to Tracen Academy to look for 
her, I found El Condor Pasa gazing up at 
the sky, as if basking in the race's 
lingering afterglow.
choice_data_list: Great job out there, I watched the race!
Great job out there, I watched the race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! Hehehe! How was it? The run of 
El, the world's strongest!
choice_data_list:
To think you're looking past the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe...

I truly felt the importance of thorough 
preparation.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I know how you feel. The wall known 
as "the world's strongest" is just that 
steep and high.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However, success only comes to those who 
take on the challenge. ...In that case——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose, I just have to keep 
challenging it ——as many times as it 
takes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely, she will spread her wings one day. 
Crossing the ocean to distant foreign 
lands, to prove she is the strongest in 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ——El Cóndor Pasa. (The Condor flies on.)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't think it'll be easy, 
you know? Which is exactly why——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I must get to training right away! So I 
can run across the world one day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the blue sky, El Condor Pasa dashed 
off with a beaming, radiant smile.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! Preparation was important, but... I'm 
so grateful to everyone who helped me out!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-senpai, Taiki-senpai, and all of 
them! Preparing perfectly all on my own 
would have been completely impossible for 
El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's why... in order to go on overseas 
expeditions, I realized we need to join 
forces with even more people!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the strongest in the world with 
a huge team, that is El's dream, desu! 
Let's see, the name should be—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Team El Condor Pasa —how does that sound!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Even while in Japan, there's 
plenty we can do, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So I won't spare any effort! All so I can 
race across the world one day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the blue sky, El Condor Pasa flashed 
a beaming, radiant smile.
